categories.name: Normal Round (Glitchless)
categories.rules:
- Video evidence is required
- The use of Glitches is banned in this category
- Include the ingame time shown at the end of the map
- It is recommended to include the intro screen to show the map name
- Maps that include buttons or similar interactables that affect pathing needs to be activated exclusively by the runner

Record a run from start to finish in a normal round.
Only the ingame time needs to be submitted, real time should be left blank.
